body:
> Eod · Summit Az · 2026-10-13

Tuesday. Summit AZ fall blog work.

# Summit Plumbing Pros AZ
See [Summit Plumbing Pros AZ (Hub)](lib:brain-summit-plumbing-pros-az-hub).
- Picked 3 fall topics after checking People Also Ask, [Search Atlas](lib:brain-search-atlas) and existing posts: water heater flushing, grease in drain, garbage disposal not working. Cannibalization check (Rank Math keywords, page text, GSC) cleared all 3.
- Published /blog/grease-in-drain/ in plain language using Mesa, Chandler and Tempe city website facts, with SEO title, meta, FAQ and schema; second featured image version after the first was rejected. Indexing requested.
- Added links to it from the garbage disposal and clogged drains posts.
- Fixed wrong advice on the clogged drains post (hot water flush pushes grease further down per the city sites), on the page and in FAQ schema.
- Page tracker synced: 224 pages.

# Follow-ups
- Oct 27: check whether the grease post is indexed and getting impressions.
- Next topics ready: water heater flushing, garbage disposal not working.
- Move the tracker share pin to the new version.
